text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The weekend was peaceful in Gostivar and Tetovo following July 9 clashes between Macedonian police and ethnic Albanian protesters. Life is returning to normal in these two municipalities in western Macedonia.

- Macedonian foreign ministry handed a protest note to the Albanian ambassador in Skopje: "the Albanian protest against (Macedonian) police action in Gostsivar and Tetovo is an act of direct interference in the internal affairs of the republic of Macedonia."
- Ethnic Albanian municipalities in western Macedonia Chegrane and Srbinovo took down the Albanian flag without police intervention.
- Bitola mayor Siljan Micevski will appear in court on Thursday because of his alleged involvment in the scandal of the bankrupt TAT financial society from Bitola.

- Ethnic Albanian officials in the border town of Debar organised peaceful demonstrations on Friday against the brutality of the Macedonian police and in support of the use of the national Albanian flag.
